title: 2024 Lane Thomas Bowman Chrome Mega Mojo Washington Nationals #75 Guardians
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2024 Bowman Chrome Mega sports trading card features Lane Thomas, a player for the Washington Nationals in the Major League Baseball. The card is made of card stock material and has a parallel/variety of Mojo. It has a card number of 75 and is part of the 2024 set.

This item is protected by being sleeved, top loaded, and sealed in a bag. It is in English language and manufactured by Bowman in the United States. The card is not autographed and is not a vintage item. It is perfect for any baseball fan or collector of sports trading cards.
